evidence.quote: Weight is the force generated by the gravitational attraction of the earth on any object.
The weight W, or gravitational force, is then just the mass of an object times the gravitational acceleration.
On the surface of the earth, its value is 9.8 meters per square second or 32.2 feet per square second.
If the airplane weighs 10000 pounds on the surface of the earth, it weighs 9965 pounds at 35000 feet

concepts.name: Gravitational acceleration and variation with altitude

objectives: Define weight as mass times gravitational acceleration
Describe universal gravitation in terms of masses and distance
Explain why weight decreases slightly with altitude
